findings.highlight: While the moonlight shines, she makes her way through the dark hallway
findings.evidenceJa: 月明かりに照らされていながら一寸先も見えぬ通路
findings.governingReading: Although moonlight falls on the passage, she cannot see even an inch ahead as she crosses it.
findings.explanation: The opening reduces a paradoxically lighted but impenetrable passage to an ordinary dark hallway.

findings.highlight: a room of a random building
findings.governingReading: The scene identifies only a room in a certain or unspecified building.
findings.explanation: An unidentified building becomes “a random building,” in an unidiomatic construction that adds arbitrariness.

findings.highlight: Stop mansplaining and open the windows
findings.evidenceJa: 能書きはいいから窓を開けて
findings.governingReading: Rin cuts off Archer's commentary and tells him to help open the windows.
findings.explanation: Rin's dismissal of Archer's commentary becomes the gendered rebuke “mansplaining.” Their discussion concerns men and women, but the Japanese interruption does not characterize his explanation in those terms.

findings.highlight: Though she was careful not to touch things for the most part, the scent of rust still made it onto her.
findings.evidenceJa: 特別触れたワケではないが、彼女のコートには錆びた鉄の匂いが移っていた
findings.governingReading: She had not particularly touched anything, yet the rusty-iron smell had transferred to her coat.
findings.explanation: The pervasive transfer of blood’s iron smell without meaningful contact becomes a deliberate effort that mostly avoided contact, and the coat becomes Rin generally.

findings.highlight: we gave away the scope of our power.
findings.evidenceJa: こちらは手の内を晒してしまった
findings.governingReading: He says their concealed techniques or available cards were revealed to an observer.
findings.explanation: Archer’s complaint that they exposed their hand becomes disclosure of the extent of their power.

findings.highlight: his identity...or the identity of that powerful Noble Phantasm
findings.evidenceJa: その正体—あれほどに強力な“宝具”の正体を
findings.governingReading: The second 正体 specifies the first: Rin does not know the identity of the powerful Noble Phantasm fired as an arrow.
findings.explanation: The Japanese identifies the weapon as the mystery Rin cannot solve. English additionally says that she has not discovered Archer's identity.

findings.highlight: Servants typically only wield one Noble Phantasm
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントが持つ宝具はただ一つであり
findings.governingReading: Within Rin’s present model, a Servant’s Noble Phantasm is singular and is the other half that remained with the hero in life.
findings.explanation: Rin’s categorical current belief that a Servant has only one Noble Phantasm is revised into the qualified claim that Servants “typically” wield one.

findings.highlight: You can't stand without starting a fight
findings.evidenceJa: 喧嘩を売らなければ気が済まない
findings.governingReading: He observes that Rin will not be satisfied unless she picks a fight.
findings.explanation: Archer says Rin cannot be satisfied without picking a fight. “Can’t stand without starting a fight” loses what she cannot stand or what would satisfy her.

findings.highlight: we don't have to worry about them.
findings.evidenceJa: 別に目の仇にする必要ないじゃない
findings.governingReading: Because Rin insists Saber can be disposed of at any time, she says there is no need to make Saber a special object of hostility.
findings.explanation: Rin’s claim that Saber need not be singled out as a hated enemy becomes the milder claim that they need not worry about her.
